# Power Import

> > Power Import is a Dutch specialty retailer for powerlifting, strength training, and fitness equipment, featuring brands like Strength Shop, Proud, and XXL Nutrition.

The site offers comprehensive strength training equipment including IPF-approved powerlifting gear, Olympic barbells (Texas Power Bar, 2029 Original), bumper plates, racks, calisthenics equipment, and sports nutrition supplements. Power Import serves the Dutch fitness community with professional-grade equipment for powerlifting, weightlifting, and functional training.

## Key Topics

- Powerlifting equipment
- Strength Shop brand
- IPF-approved gear
- Olympic barbells (50mm)
- Texas Power Bar
- Bumper plates
- Calisthenics training
- Resistance bands
- Lifting straps & wrist wraps
- Squat racks & stands
- Fitness mobility
- Sports supplements (XXL Nutrition)
- Grip training
- Krachttraining (strength training)

## Main Product Categories

- [Sportmateriaal & Krachttraining Gear](https://powerimport.nl/sportmateriaal): Main product overview: barbells, weights, gear, supplements & apparel
- [Halterstangen - Barbells](https://powerimport.nl/product-categorie/halters-gewichten/halterstangen): Barbell category: 50mm powerlifting, weightlifting & specialty bars
- [Krachtapparatuur - Strength Equipment](https://powerimport.nl/product-categorie/apparatuur): Strength equipment category featuring racks & squat stands
- [Fitness & Mobility Producten](https://powerimport.nl/product-categorie/fitness-mobility): Fitness & mobility category: calisthenics, massage, resistance bands

## Powerlifting & Olympic Lifting

- [Powerlifting Barbells](https://powerimport.nl/product-categorie/halters-gewichten/halterstangen/powerlifting-barbell): Powerlifting barbells: Texas Power Bar & 2029 Original for heavy lifts
- [Riot Bumper Plates - Coloured](https://powerimport.nl/winkel/strength-shop-riot-bumper-plates-gekleurd): Strength Shop coloured bumper plates following IWF/IPF color standards
- [Medium Wrist Wraps - IPF Approved](https://powerimport.nl/winkel/medium-wrist-wraps-dark-camo-print-ipf-goedgekeurd): IPF-approved dark camo wrist wraps (30cm/60cm) for powerlifting support
- [Original Lifting Straps - Cotton](https://powerimport.nl/winkel/original-lifting-straps-khaki-cotton): Strength Shop khaki cotton lifting straps for grip support & deadlifts

## Featured Brands

- [Strength Shop](https://powerimport.nl/merk/strength-shop): Strength Shop brand page: powerlifting equipment & lifting straps
- [Proud](https://powerimport.nl/merk/proud): Proud brand page featuring Black Edition 20KG Olympic barbell

## Calisthenics & Functional Training

- [Calisthenics Apparatuur](https://powerimport.nl/product-categorie/fitness-mobility/calisthenics): Calisthenics equipment: dipping belts & pull-up accessories
- [Weerstandsbanden - Resistance Bands](https://powerimport.nl/product-categorie/fitness-mobility/weerstandsbanden): Resistance bands subcategory with InnovaGoods Glutes Trainer
- [Naudiz Aqua Powerbag 15L](https://powerimport.nl/winkel/naudiz-aqua-powerbag-15l): Naudiz 15L water powerbag for dynamic full-body & core stability training

- [Fruits Veggies & Greens](https://powerimport.nl/winkel/fruits-veggies-greens): XXL Nutrition superfood supplement with 31 fruits & vegetables blend
